notes.title: September Update: Giving Animas a Voice & A Playtest is Coming!
notes.notes: [p]Hello everyone![/p][p]This past month has been incredibly productive, and we're getting closer and closer to the release of the [i]Animas[/i] demo. While we don't want to announce a specific date just yet—we want to make sure every detail is polished to perfection—we can tell you that it's just around the corner. In fact, September has probably been one of the months with the most significant progress since we started development.[/p][p]The most important and exciting milestone of the month was, without a doubt, [b]recording the voice lines[/b]. It was a deeply satisfying process to see the story we wrote almost a year ago finally come to life through talented actors. We want the experience to be authentic in every sense, and that includes real human voices that convey every nuance of the horror we're building.[/p][p]Here’s a short behind-the-scenes look at the recording process:[/p][previewyoutube="QNOGZrOUGLs;full"][/previewyoutube][p]With the voices recorded and integrated, we've been able to assemble the complete narrative skeleton of the demo. This means it's now playable from start to finish—a huge step forward for us.[/p][p]Now, our work is focused on breathing life and soul into that skeleton. Over the last few weeks, we've been diving deep into:[/p][list][*][p][b]Populating the environments:[/b] Adding the final 3D models and detailed textures so that every corner of the house tells its own story.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Crafting the atmosphere:[/b] Playing with lighting and shadows to build the oppressive tension we're aiming for.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Polishing the immersion:[/b] Implementing key animations and, of course, fine-tuning the scares to make them truly effective.[/p][/*][/list][p]You can see some of that work here:[/p][p][/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535654/0aac9a5b8fca9f92dfc5ecbac21de7d180272b3c.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535654/2dc7a8baf1f9e15e091fde15361371ccfa2ae747.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535654/8f30684466d1c1051b9f2afb7bac4f811282bccf.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535654/417778d54547c0c8dddeedd3309bf542e3e31b00.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535654/88fbbfb900d371871cf7f0a7f6ba9afdda682ea9.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535654/8c84b253f22d469cd4f1476b8a428b34c5584f75.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535654/49f09be5073af6224042f10525dfb66df167431d.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535654/aedc9b4bf7e0aa5d8861b55eed9894c705e9d7f3.png"][/img][/carousel][p]And now, for one last very important piece of news. Very soon, we will be granting access to test [i]Animas[/i] for the first time through a [b]public playtest[/b]. We are eager to receive your first impressions and feedback, which will be incredibly valuable to us. This will be a unique opportunity for you to get a "behind-the-scenes" look at the game and help us shape the final experience.[/p][p]Stay tuned, because we'll be making the official announcement in the coming days.[/p][p]As always, thank you for joining us on this journey![/p][p]– The Apamate Studio Team[/p]

notes.title: What have we been up to? An Animas Dev Update
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

It's been a while since we shared our announcement trailer, and first of all, we wanted to thank you. The truth is, the reception Animas received took us by surprise, in the best possible way. In these few months, thanks to you, we've surpassed [b]3000 wishlists[/b], a milestone that has filled us with motivation and energy.

While you were showing us your incredible support, we've been completely immersed in the Blanco family home. As we've progressed, we've realized something: the potential of this project is much greater than we had anticipated. Therefore, to do justice to the game you've shown us you want to see, we've made the decision to adjust our launch schedule for the full game.

But the good news is that you won't have to wait that long to set foot in the house. Our immediate plan, where we are focusing all our efforts, is to release [b]Animas: Prologue[/b] this year. It will be a standalone, self-contained experience that will serve as a first dive into the unsettling universe of Animas.

[carousel autoadvance="true"][img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/45535654/56e6d2e7eb1c287b2de2e3e468a452d7085d4a52.png[/img][img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/45535654/8bb5de3de4720263bdad9f0fefecb31e8c3fc9aa.png[/img][/carousel]

Setting a game in the Venezuelan mountains across different eras means that almost every object you'll see—from the furniture and the food on the table, to the specific religious icons that adorn the walls—is being modeled and textured by hand by us. It's meticulous and time-consuming work, but it's the only way to achieve the cultural authenticity we consider to be the core of this project.

As you can imagine, a larger project and an extended development schedule also mean a greater need for resources. As a self-funded independent studio, to get Animas to the finish line with the quality we all expect, we are actively exploring our options. This includes looking for a publisher who shares our vision, as well as the possibility of a crowdfunding campaign in the future.

For now, the most powerful and direct way you can help us is super simple: [b]add and keep Animas on your Steam Wishlist.[/b] Spreading the word about the game also helps us a lot. Every wishlist is a vote of confidence that boosts us enormously on the platform; it tells Steam and potential partners that there is a real and excited community waiting for this game.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/45535654/0c4dedfde703331f69b0e7461bd5c73f57fcf0ed.gif[/img]

Again, thank you from the bottom of our hearts for your patience, your trust, and for joining us on this journey. We are pouring all our passion into this project and we're dying to have you visit the Blanco family home for the first time in [b]Animas: Prologue[/b].

All the best,

Wilmar & Wilderman
Apamate Studio
